item5.percentageOfClassSecurities: Reference to percentage ownership of the Common Stock in this Schedule 13D are based on 590,543,159 shares of Common Stock, issued and outstanding as of August 5, 2026, as reported by the Issuer in its Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q filed on August 10, 2026. As of the date of this Schedule 13D, LDB 2025 LLC is the beneficial owner of 3,000,000 shares of Common Stock (approximately 0.51% of the Common Stock), which it holds directly. LDB 2025 LLC has sole voting and sole dispositive power with respect to such shares. By virtue of the agreements made pursuant to the Stockholders Agreement, the parties thereto, including the Reporting Person, may be deemed to be acting as a group for purposes of Rule 13d-3 under the Exchange Act. Based on public filings, the parties to the Stockholders Agreement, as a group, may be deemed to beneficially own an aggregate of 146,753,672 shares of Common Stock (approximately 24.9% of the Common Stock). The Reporting Person disclaims beneficial ownership of any securities owned by such other parties. Only the shares of Common Stock beneficially owned by the Reporting Person are the subject of this Schedule 13D. For a description of the relationship between the Reporting Person and the other parties to the Stockholders Agreement, see Item 4.
